name: Modal
summary: Modal is a cloud platform for AI workloads, offering elastic compute, inference, training, batch jobs, and isolated sandboxes through code-first developer tooling.
overview: Modal provides cloud infrastructure for AI developers. Its platform is built for elastic inference, training, agent runtimes, batch jobs, and sandboxed execution.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Modal reported a $4.65B post-money valuation for its Series C.

bull_case: Modal's code-first approach and broad workload support can make it an important operating layer for AI teams that need scalable compute without managing infrastructure directly.
bear_case: Cloud incumbents and specialist GPU providers can compete aggressively on capacity and price, while AI infrastructure economics remain capital intensive.
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: Modal offers cloud infrastructure for AI workloads, from training and inference to agent sandboxes and batch jobs.
company: Modal is a cloud platform designed around AI workloads rather than traditional web applications. Developers use it for inference, training, batch processing, reinforcement learning, and isolated execution environments for agents.
In May 2026, Modal announced a $355 million Series C at a $4.65 billion post-money valuation. It said annualized revenue had surpassed $300 million after growing fivefold since September.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Modal is a signal of where value may accrue in AI infrastructure: not only in chips and model providers, but in the software layer that makes demanding workloads usable by developers.

changed.text: Profile reviewed against available public information.

takeaways: Modal provides elastic cloud infrastructure for AI workloads and agents.
The May 2026 Series C raised $355 million at a $4.65 billion post-money valuation.
Modal reported more than $300 million in annualized revenue at that time.
Capacity economics and competition from larger cloud platforms are the major risks.
